'''Hanera's Dance Troupe''' was an entertainment company in the [[Old Galactic Market]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Around [[3643 BBY]], the Troupe was based out of the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild headquarters|headquarters]] of the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]], a criminal syndicate comprised of [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]]. During this time, Hanera's Dance Troupe employed many erotic dancers, primarily [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]], although one [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]], [[Ria Deleru]], did elect to join the Troupe.
